description: BETA: Historical data (>today) from proxy_requests_daily_summary. Today's data from proxy_requests (raw). Default range: last 7 days.

panels.title: Summary — today from raw · history from daily_summary

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM proxies WHERE active = true AND location IN ($location)

SELECT SUM(total_requests) as value FROM (
  SELECT SUM(s.total_requests) as total_requests
  FROM proxy_requests_daily_summary s
  JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
  WHERE s.day >= DATE($__timeFrom()) AND s.day < CURDATE()
    AND p.location IN ($location)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total_requests
  FROM proxy_requests r
  JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id
  WHERE DATE(r.timestamp) = CURDATE()
    AND p.location IN ($location)
) combined

SELECT ROUND(SUM(success_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(total_requests), 0), 2) as value FROM (
  SELECT SUM(s.success_count) as success_count, SUM(s.total_requests) as total_requests
  FROM proxy_requests_daily_summary s
  JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
  WHERE s.day >= DATE($__timeFrom()) AND s.day < CURDATE()
    AND p.location IN ($location)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) as success_count,
    COUNT(*) as total_requests
  FROM proxy_requests r
  JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id
  WHERE DATE(r.timestamp) = CURDATE()
    AND p.location IN ($location)
) combined

SELECT ROUND(SUM(weighted_ms) / NULLIF(SUM(total_requests), 0), 0) as value FROM (
  SELECT SUM(s.avg_response_time_ms * s.total_requests) as weighted_ms, SUM(s.total_requests) as total_requests
  FROM proxy_requests_daily_summary s
  JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
  WHERE s.day >= DATE($__timeFrom()) AND s.day < CURDATE()
    AND p.location IN ($location)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    SUM(r.response_time_ms) as weighted_ms,
    COUNT(*) as total_requests
  FROM proxy_requests r
  JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id
  WHERE DATE(r.timestamp) = CURDATE()
    AND r.response_time_ms IS NOT NULL
    AND p.location IN ($location)
) combined

panels.title: Trends — daily bars from summary · hourly resolution for today

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_sec, total_requests FROM (
  SELECT
    UNIX_TIMESTAMP(s.day) as time_sec,
    SUM(s.total_requests) as total_requests
  FROM proxy_requests_daily_summary s
  JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
  WHERE s.day >= DATE($__timeFrom()) AND s.day < CURDATE()
    AND p.location IN ($location)
  GROUP BY s.day
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(r.timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00')) as time_sec,
    COUNT(*) as total_requests
  FROM proxy_requests r
  JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id
  WHERE DATE(r.timestamp) = CURDATE()
    AND p.location IN ($location)
  GROUP BY UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(r.timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00'))
) combined
ORDER BY time_sec

SELECT time_sec, success_rate FROM (
  SELECT
    UNIX_TIMESTAMP(s.day) as time_sec,
    ROUND(SUM(s.success_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_requests), 0), 2) as success_rate
  FROM proxy_requests_daily_summary s
  JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
  WHERE s.day >= DATE($__timeFrom()) AND s.day < CURDATE()
    AND p.location IN ($location)
  GROUP BY s.day
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(r.timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00')) as time_sec,
    ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) as success_rate
  FROM proxy_requests r
  JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id
  WHERE DATE(r.timestamp) = CURDATE()
    AND p.location IN ($location)
  GROUP BY UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(r.timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00'))
) combined
ORDER BY time_sec

panels.title: Per-Proxy Daily Summary — history from aggregate table · today from raw

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day, proxy_name, location, total_requests, success_count, failure_count, ROUND(success_rate_pct, 1) as success_rate_pct, ROUND(avg_response_ms, 0) as avg_response_ms, ROUND(p95_response_ms, 0) as p95_response_ms, timeout_count, source FROM (
  SELECT
    s.day,
    COALESCE(p.name, s.proxy_id) as proxy_name,
    s.location,
    s.total_requests,
    s.success_count,
    s.failure_count,
    s.success_rate_pct,
    s.avg_response_time_ms as avg_response_ms,
    s.p95_response_time_ms as p95_response_ms,
    s.timeout_count,
    'summary' as source
  FROM proxy_requests_daily_summary s
  JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
  WHERE s.day >= DATE($__timeFrom()) AND s.day < CURDATE()
    AND p.location IN ($location)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CURDATE() as day,
    COALESCE(p.name, p.device_id) as proxy_name,
    p.location,
    COUNT(*) as total_requests,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) as success_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status != 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) as failure_count,
    ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) as success_rate_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(r.response_time_ms), 0) as avg_response_ms,
    NULL as p95_response_ms,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status = 'TIMEOUT' THEN 1 END) as timeout_count,
    'raw (today)' as source
  FROM proxy_requests r
  JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id
  WHERE r.timestamp >= CURDATE()
    AND r.timestamp < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY
    AND p.location IN ($location)
  GROUP BY p.device_id, p.name, p.location
) combined
ORDER BY day DESC, total_requests DESC
